Overview

The design principle here is simple: models, agents and rules move through versioned, evaluated releases for Public Sector & Government at scale, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence. In Public Sector & Government the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: GDPR / privacy regimes shapes what data may move, service standards dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
